goal: A task that finishes verify with an empty or uncommitted change under a git landing strategy is not recorded as a landed success but is re-driven by bounded retry, while a committed change lands through the unchanged submit path.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00061-FEATURE-landable-change-gate.md -- criteria #1, #2, #3, #4, #5, #6 and decisions D-1, D-2, D-3

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the Status.DONE post-run / pre-submit site (~line 1245) where the held-out gate already runs; invoke the landability predicate here and route a non-landable DONE to a retryable non-terminal outcome before submit

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_held_out_gate.py -- the held-out gate is the model for a git-aware decision fed in at the DONE site without core knowing git exists; mirror its placement, not its content
packages/flywheel-core -- the lease/claim and max-retries machinery the re-drive reuses; do NOT add git awareness here
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/ -- mirror test_held_out_gate*/test_orchestrator* for the gate's held-out proofs; keep existing suites green
constraints: Invoke the strategy-supplied landability predicate at the existing Status.DONE site, before the held-out gate/submit. On a non-landable verdict, do NOT land as DONE: route to a retryable non-terminal outcome so the existing retry/lease/work-source path re-drives the task against the same base (D-2).
Retry is bounded by the existing max-retries budget; a task that never commits ends FAILED (not DONE) with a recorded reason naming the non-landable change -- never an infinite loop.
When the predicate reports landable (or the no-op default), the post-run path is byte-for-byte unchanged: the held-out gate and submit run exactly as today.
flywheel-core and the orchestrator gain no git/commit awareness -- the predicate is the only place git is touched (criterion #6, D-1).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT implement the cross-task coherence oracle or autopilot conflict_keys (Gap 3, out of scope).
Do NOT alter the merge-flock, rebase/re-verify, or protected-paths logic.
Do not weaken or delete existing test assertions; add new tests only.
edge_cases: Agent reaches verify with an uncommitted tree on attempt 1, commits on attempt 2 -> attempt 1 is not a landed success, the task is re-driven, attempt 2 lands the committed change (criterion #1).
Branch has zero commits beyond base -> not recorded as a landed success, base unchanged (criterion #2).
A non-git/non-code task with the no-op predicate -> reaches DONE on the first attempt with no spurious retry (criterion #3).
Concurrency/exactly-once: a re-driven non-landable DONE must not mint a double-run -- respects post-4dc477b claim/lease semantics (criterion #4).
Never-commits task -> exhausts max-retries and surfaces FAILED with a recorded reason, no infinite loop (criterion #4 bound).
Committed change -> lands via the unchanged submit path; existing held-out-gate ordering preserved (criterion #5).
